subject: circuits

milestone.title: MOSFET operating regions
milestone.objective: Decide the operating region of an NMOS in a biased circuit and compute I_D and V_DS, in under 10 minutes

sources.title: Course notes p.58 (fixture)
sources.text: n-channel enhancement MOSFET, threshold voltage Vt. Cutoff: VGS < Vt, and ID = 0. Triode: VGS > Vt and VDS < VGS - Vt. Saturation: VGS > Vt and VDS >= VGS - Vt; in saturation ID = (1/2) kn (VGS - Vt)^2, where kn = un Cox W/L. The overdrive voltage is VOV = VGS - Vt. Method: assume saturation, compute ID, then VDS, then check VDS >= VOV; if the check fails, redo the analysis in triode. Example: kn = 2 mA/V^2, Vt = 1 V, VGS = 2 V gives VOV = 1 V and ID = 0.5 x 2 x 1^2 = 1 mA. With RD = 2 kilohm and VDD = 5 V, VDS = 5 - 1 x 2 = 3 V, which is at least VOV = 1 V, so the transistor is in saturation as assumed.

lesson_lines: With $k_n = 2$ mA/V², $V_t = 1$ V and $V_{GS} = 2$ V: assume saturation, so $I_D$ = ½ × 2 × 1² = 2 mA.
Then $V_{DS} = V_{DD} - I_D R_D$, and checking $V_{DS} \ge V_{OV}$ confirms the assumption.
Change RD to 5k in the netlist. Find $I_D$ and $V_{DS}$ and decide the region.

planted_errors.why: Saturation is V_DS >= V_GS - V_t; V_DS < V_GS - V_t is the triode condition (source).
0.5 × 2 mA/V² × (1 V)² = 1 mA; the course notes give the same example.
